Jegga comes from bats living in underground cavities. The relevant species occurs in certain temperate regions; identifying and obtaining the animal is the main challenge before the poison can be prepared.

The usable substance is a brown paste that immediately causes 1–100 concussion hits when poisoning takes effect. Despite the potentially considerable damage, its general respiratory effects are limited to Mild in RMU. The entry therefore distinguishes immediate injuries from the other respiratory symptoms.
